text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I recalled the words my father once told 
me long ago.

text_block_list.name: Shion's Father
text_block_list.text:
"My dad has a rival. He's an ally, a 
friend... and the one person he refuses to 
lose to."

text_block_list.name: Shion's Father
text_block_list.text:
"It was because of him that I could bring 
out my strength. That I could reach it. 
Heading straight towards that place."

text_block_list.name: Shion's Father
text_block_list.text:
"To become the most beautiful, shining 
figure —the leading star."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Back then—no, probably until right this 
second, I never truly understood the 
meaning of those words.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
He's being humble and says it's thanks to 
others, but it's really the fruit of my 
dad's hard work.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: That's—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!! Haaaaaaahhhhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Dad... Those words really did come 
straight from your heart, didn't they?)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation is in the lead! Win 
Variation takes the lead!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Unstoppable! —Win Variation crosses the 
finish line!"

Win Variation's fierce struggle made the 
entire racecourse tremble.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa! ...Khh!

text_block_list.name: Shion Fan A
text_block_list.text:
That Bari-yan has gotten so cool...! 
Whoaaa! Congratulations--!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Crazy goosebumps! I just witnessed 
something incredible! I came to see Orfe, 
but isn't Win Variation amazing?!

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation...! It's because you were 
there that Orfevre could shine so 
brightly!

text_block_list.name: Shion Fan B
text_block_list.text:
She's shining so bright after all! The 
absolute best leading star!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: —Always.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Watching them shine as they climbed ever 
higher, leaving me far behind... it hurt.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I don't like how I keep reaching out again 
and again, refusing to learn my lesson, 
either.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'm so far from being an ideal 
protagonist, to tell the truth... The more 
I chase it, the further away it feels—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: However. Right now, though—
(WOOOOO...!!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Thunderous cheers that make you tremble— 
The racetrack is roaring. It's glowing.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Is this... the view seen by the 
protagonist?)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Ha, haha.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...I'm glad it didn't end.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad she's not the type to let me 
quit.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad... she was the ultimate 
lead...!

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for giving us the greatest 
showdown for your final domestic race—!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Or... fe...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Because you— because you guided me, I...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, aaah!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Sentimentality—or is it rage? ...No...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. This is—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "Jealousy", is it?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—Insolent fool. Making me carry such 
unnecessary baggage as well.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...What made you like this?

To whom was it directed? With tears still 
streaming down her face, she bowed deeply, 
a figure that—

"Amidst the murmurs of the crowd, she 
captured the gazes and hearts of many."

The applause that had faded surges once 
more, enveloping her trembling figure.

Just like a spotlight shining bright on 
the stage.
